title: Custom Views | A criterion on a field hidden from the viewer exposes its value in the view editor and the view API
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) · ndc-staging-owner (view author), test user 1 (User profile, Company hidden)

panels.caption: Test user 1 opens Edit on the owner's shared view "QA RT k7" (Company equals "test"): banner names the hidden field, the criterion row shows no value.

rows: "Some fields in this view's criteria are deleted or hidden from you: …"
Shown: "… hidden from you: company. The view still filters on them."
Editor never shows the hidden value
Criterion row empty (Select a field / Operator / Value) — "test" appears nowhere
View API never returns the value
Masked view cannot be saved back
Save blocked client-side ("Complete this row…", no request sent); owner GET still company = "test"
Grid still returns "Test Workqueue" to test user 1, so the value can be inferred — developer flagged this as a product decision
First editor load hung on "Loading fields…" > 15 s; reload worked
